## Description {#details}

<p>This struct provides an overload for <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/castinfo">CastInfo</a> where From has <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/simplify-type">simplify_type</a> defined.</p>


<p>This simply forwards to the appropriate <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/castinfo">CastInfo</a> with the simplified type/value, so you don't have to implement both.</p>


<p>Definition at line 503 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/support/casting-h">Casting.h</a>.</p>
